summary: Exactly one email arrived on 2026-10-02: the automated daily Healthpoint Hacker News digest covering stories from 01.10.2026, sent by the bot to itself and a small distribution list. It flagged 24 health/medicine/biotech-related Hacker News stories (hospital pricing transparency, aging research, a deadlift-form vision tool, ultra-processed food study, etc.) plus the day's top 10 general Hacker News stories (Pi 1.0, StreetComplete iOS beta, Cloudflare's Clef models, and others). No other emails were received that day.
